translation.name: Minsang Kim
translation.title1: A developer who wants to change the world with better products.
translation.title2: A colleague who always wants to work joyfully together.
translation.title3: A creator who builds products for customers.
translation.introDescription:
'Familiar with Novelty'. I am comfortable learning new technologies, have experience using the recently emerging functional programming paradigm, and am a 'learner and sharer' by seeking out and learning what I don't know and sharing what I know with others.

I have knowledge about computer graphics and am interested in systematically configuring GUIs to provide a beautiful user experience.
